name: 03253 · Meredith, NH
findings: ZIP 03253 (Meredith) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.

40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
